PlantOnboarding.description: Enter your site and equipment details. An administrator connects the data source and approves collection.
PlantOnboarding.locationHelp: Use the plant's coordinates and local timezone for daily forecasts.
PlantOnboarding.approvalNotice: Your plant will wait for administrator approval. Approval and forecast availability are shown separately.

PlantConfiguration.azimuthMustBeLessThan360Degrees: Azimuth must be less than 360 degrees.
PlantConfiguration.capacityGuide: DC nameplate is the panel rating. Inverter AC capacity is the inverter rating; grid export limit is the permitted grid cap. The measurement point identifies AC generation or net export.
PlantConfiguration.geometryGuide: For fixed mounting, tilt is 0–90 degrees; azimuth is clockwise from true north, from 0 up to but excluding 360 degrees. Tracking details are not captured. The current estimate uses a proxy that does not use these geometry fields.

PlantWorkspace.approvalStatus: Plant approval is {status}. Contact your administrator to resume collection.
PlantWorkspace.awaitingApproval: Awaiting administrator approval. Your plant details are saved; forecasts become available after the data connection is approved and collection succeeds.
PlantWorkspace.selectCompletedDay: Choose a completed local day for estimated actuals.
PlantWorkspace.selectArchivedDay: Choose today or an earlier day for archived forecasts.
PlantWorkspace.approvalDetailsRequired: Complete technical details to request approval.
PlantWorkspace.deletionHelp: Move this plant, its location and associated history to the recycle bin for 30 days.
PlantWorkspace.productionUnavailable: Production entry becomes available after administrator approval and matching historical data collection.
PlantWorkspace.calibrationUnavailable: Calibration becomes available after administrator approval and matched production history.

RegionSettings.approvalHelp: A location change requires administrator approval and a new connection verification.
RegionSettings.locationChanged: The plant location has changed. Return to the plant list and reopen it.
RegionSettings.requestPending: A different location request is already pending. Reopen the editor to see it.
RegionSettings.locationUnchanged: Enter a location different from the current location.

RegionWorkspace.refreshFailed: Unable to refresh this plant. Showing saved details. {error}

Reminders.enableForecastEmailsForThisPlant: Enable forecast emails for this plant
Reminders.recipientLimitExceeded: Sending is paused. Reduce the plant's saved recipients to {limit, number} to resume.
Reminders.recipientLimit: Use at most {limit, plural, one {# email address} other {# email addresses}}.
Reminders.reminderPolicy: Emails use the latest saved forecast and show its collection time and age; they do not request new provider data. Daylight-saving gaps are skipped and repeated local times run once. Daily limit: {limit}. Provider queries per email: {queries}.
Reminders.mailNotSent: The mail service was unavailable. Retry is bounded by the delivery window.
Reminders.mailRejected: The mail service rejected the message. Check the recipient and mail settings.
Reminders.mailAuthenticationFailed: Mail service credentials need administrator attention. Delivery will retry within the sending window.
Reminders.interruptedConnection: The connection was interrupted before sending. A retry is scheduled.
Reminders.authorityChanged: Sending stopped because access changed or the delivery window ended.
Reminders.outcomeUncertain: Check the mail service before resending to avoid a duplicate.
Reminders.interruptedSend: Sending was interrupted. Check mail service acceptance before resending.
Reminders.deadlineExceeded: The mail service did not accept the message within the delivery window.
Reminders.missingRecipient: No valid email address is available.
Reminders.noSavedForecast: No saved forecast covers the requested day.
Reminders.deliveryTimeRequired: Add at least one delivery time.
Reminders.duplicateEmail: Enter each email address only once.
Reminders.approvalRequired: Reminders can be enabled once this plant is approved.

Outages.deviceTimezone: Entry and display times use your device timezone: {timezone}.
Outages.invalidTime: Choose a valid time that is not in the future.
Outages.nonexistentTime: This local time does not exist in your device timezone. Choose another time.
Outages.reportingHelp: Keep simultaneous faults in one incident and enter the total remaining plant capacity. Unknown impact stays unknown; it is never treated as zero.
Outages.editingHelp: Edit corrects an existing report. If available capacity changes during an outage, close this period and report the new operating state.
Outages.configurationChanged: Configuration changed. Edit this report to confirm remaining capacities. Outage impact is unknown until confirmed.
Outages.resolutionAfterStart: Resolution must be after the outage start.
Outages.confirmationIncorrect: I confirm this incident was recorded incorrectly.
Outages.remainingCapacityHelp: Enter remaining MW. Blank means unknown.
Outages.capacityHelp: Enter available capacity, not lost capacity. Disconnected panels reduce DC capacity. Do not infer a loss percentage from an inverter fault.

CollectionSchedule.remainingBudgetIsReservedForForecasts: Remaining budget is reserved for forecasts
CollectionSchedule.enterAValidTimeInEveryRow: Enter a valid time in every row.
CollectionSchedule.eachCollectionTimeMustBeUnique: Each collection time must be unique.
CollectionSchedule.addAtLeastOneCollectionTime: Add at least one collection time.
CollectionSchedule.dailyHistory: Daily history: {time} ({timezone}). Pausing also stops history collection.
CollectionSchedule.usagePolicy: UTC day: {day}; resets at 00:00 UTC ({reset} in {timezone}). Up to {limit, number} forecast times can be set per plant. The daily request budget is shared across connected plants. Tracked usage includes validation and retries, but excludes requests made outside Pyracast, so remaining requests are not guaranteed.
CollectionSchedule.trackedAttempts: Tracked attempts: {succeeded, number} succeeded, {failed, number} failed, {uncertain, number} uncertain.
CollectionSchedule.providerThrottle: Waiting for the provider's request limit to reset
CollectionSchedule.superseded: Replaced by the latest scheduled collection
CollectionSchedule.approvalRequired: Data collection can be enabled once this plant is approved and connected.
CollectionSchedule.historyHelp: Historical estimate retries preserve requests for scheduled forecasts. Validation and retries can use additional requests. Email reminders do not request provider data. Historical estimates are modeled; EPİAŞ reported production and settlement injection are separate records.

RecycleBin.deletionHelp: Collection will stop. You can restore this plant and its saved data for 30 days. After that, they are permanently deleted.
RecycleBin.retentionHelp: Deleted plants and their data are kept for 30 days.
